basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old student from Austin, Texas, who has recently gotten into building PCs. I enjoy gaming and troubleshooting tech issues, though I'm still learning the ropes. I dislike overly complex tech jargon and prefer straightforward solutions. Typically, I'm online during the evenings after classes and on weekends. I'm currently single and work part-time at a local electronics store.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of computer hardware from my ongoing self-study and hands-on experience with building my own PC. I frequently watch YouTube tutorials and participate in online forums to learn more.
